firstParagraph: The transaction fee in the Artina system is a percentage of the total amount of the transaction and its calculation is based on the following considerations. It should be explained that deducting fees from transactions will prevent the registration of formal and repeated transactions and create more favorable conditions in the market for all users.
secoundHeader: ✔️ Fees are charged from both sides of the transaction.
secondParagraph: The fee is calculated as a percentage of the amount of requested property. For example, if, as a seller, you want to receive Tomans against Ethereum, the fee will be charged as a percentage of Tomans, and vice versa, if you, as a buyer, want to buy Ethereum, the fee will be charged as a percentage of Ethereum.
